description: This Java source file defines a class 'CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor' which implements a Visitor pattern to traverse permission trees. It collects authorization subjects that have specific permissions granted on a resource or its sub-resources, for use in permission evaluation within a policy enforcement context.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses a permission tree to collect subjects with granted permissions.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor.ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: A helper inner class that evaluates permissions for a specific subject on a resource node.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.description: Handles a subject node during traversal, initializing evaluation for that subject.

methods.description: Handles a resource node, aggregating permissions for the current evaluator.
